source: Verified research, Factory Droid 1.17 ([Droid] rows of the Zed/Aider/Goose/Droid/Auggie/Junie entry): docs.factory.com/reference/hooks-reference (skeptic: hook_pre_tool, hook_session_start and hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: Droid's hooks are Claude Code compatible and its encoder writes the claude bytes, so no sniff is needed; --agent droid is what the installer renders.

deny.source: [Droid] hook_pre_tool: exit 0 with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny and permissionDecisionReason.

context.source: [Droid] hook_session_start: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, or plain stdout on exit 0, is added to model context.

PreToolUse.source: Droid hook_payload_example (docs.factory.com/reference/hooks-reference), with the shell tool Execute; the doc example is Create, so Execute's command key is not documented

PostToolUse.source: [Droid] hook_post_tool: the PostToolUse payload adds tool_response

SessionStart.source: [Droid] hook_session_start: the matcher runs against source (startup, resume, clear, compact)

SessionEnd.source: [Droid] hook_pre_tool skeptic: SessionEnd is in the full event set; its input keys are not in the verified research

Stop.source: [Droid] hook_stop: Stop receives stop_hook_active, tool_execution_count and elapsed_time
